records.Summary: Execution desk cannot submit trades after FIX session disconnect
records.Description: The primary venue session has stayed disconnected for 30 minutes; four traders cannot submit orders. A secondary venue is available but requires manual rekeying.
records.Resolution text: Diagnosis: Primary venue FIX session disconnected for 30 minutes, blocking order submission. Action: Investigate session logs and restart primary venue connection. Validation: Confirm session re-establishment and trader ability to submit orders post-restart. Access check: No access issues identified; no provisioning needed.

_triage.reason: Trading desk unable to submit orders due to primary venue session disconnect, directly impacting execution of trades and business operations.

records.Summary: Stale bond price from overnight source
records.Description: The pricing snapshot for a bond did not refresh and the price tolerance control blocked today's valuation for one fund.
records.Resolution text: Diagnosed: Stale bond price from overnight source triggered price tolerance block. Action: Verify source refresh schedule and initiate manual refresh. Validation: Confirm price update in pricing snapshot and fund valuation success. Approval required for source access if needed.

_triage.reason: A stale bond price blocked today's valuation for a fund, affecting a critical pricing service with financial counterparties.

records.Description: A new relationship manager needs the client interaction history in CRM. Manager approval is attached; no service is failing.
records.Resolution text: Access request for CRM client interaction history approved. Manager approval attached. Provisioning initiated. Validation: confirm access granted via CRM portal login and verify view of client history records for France entity.

_triage.reason: Request is for access to CRM data, a routine entitlement request with no service failure or business disruption.

records.Summary: Month-end holdings do not reconcile to ledger
records.Description: The accounting team sees a position break between the book of record and general ledger for one portfolio at close.
records.Resolution text: Diagnosis: Position break identified between book of record and general ledger for Germany portfolio at month-end. Action: Investigate reconciliation trail, validate holdings data, and confirm ledger entry timing. Validation: Confirm reconciliation matches via audit trail and close documentation. Approval required for access to ledger data.

_triage.reason: A position break between book of record and general ledger constitutes a critical accounting failure, directly impacting financial reporting and audit integrity for a portfolio.

records.Summary: Urgent outage: new SharePoint workspace needed
records.Description: No existing workspace is unavailable. Please create a document library for the project group and grant the approved members edit rights.
records.Resolution text: Ticket misclassified as 'urgent outage' despite no actual outage or service failure. Request appears to be for a standard SharePoint document library. Requesting clarification on the business need, project group members, and intended usage to ensure alignment with governance and avoid misrouting. Approval required before provisioning.

_triage.reason: Request is for creating a document library with edit rights for a project group; no service disruption or operational failure is indicated.

records.Summary: Tax analyst needs another seat for quarterly filing
records.Description: The tax lead approved an additional license for the withholding tax extract tool for a new analyst.
records.Resolution text: Confirmed the tax lead approved an additional license for the withholding tax extract tool. Provisioned the license for the new analyst in Germany. Validated access to the quarterly extract tool post-provisioning. Access check completed and confirmed successful access.

_triage.reason: The request is for an additional license to support a tax filing tool, which is a routine access requirement within the Tax Reporting service.
resolution_examples: Confirmed the withholding tax workflow license was provisioned and validated the user could access the quarterly extract tool.
Reviewed the request with the tax team lead, granted the standard processing entitlement, and verified access to the output workspace.
